name: pitwall-weather
description: Local racetrack weather comparison and session planning application

scripts.build: node scripts/notices.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-worker.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint web/src tests e2e scripts desktop playwright*.config.ts electron-builder.config.cjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run notices:check && npm run verify:pilot && npm run build
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.desktop:windows: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
